passages.text: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
passages.sermon:
The LORD listens to me.
He hears my voice.
He hears my cry for mercy.
I love the LORD.
passages.original: אָ֭הַבְתִּי כִּֽי־ יִשְׁמַ֥ע׀ יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־ ק֝וֹלִ֗י תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃

passages.text: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
passages.sermon: The LORD listens to me.\r\nHe turns His ear toward me.\r\nI will call on the LORD all my life.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הִטָּ֣ה אָזְנ֣וֹ לִ֑י וּבְיָמַ֥י אֶקְרָֽא׃

passages.text: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
passages.sermon:
Death surrounded me like ropes.
The pain of the grave found me.
I faced trouble.
I found sorrow.
passages.original: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי׀ חֶבְלֵי־ מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא׃

passages.text: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
passages.sermon:
The speaker is in trouble and sorrow.
The speaker calls on the LORD.
The speaker uses the LORD’s name.
The speaker says, “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
passages.original: וּבְשֵֽׁם־ יְהוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
passages.sermon: The LORD is gracious.\r\nThe LORD is righteous.\r\nOur God is full of compassion.

passages.text: The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD preserves the simplehearted.
The LORD watches over people who are simple and trusting.
I was helpless.
The LORD saved me.
passages.original: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לּוֹתִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

passages.text: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is gracious and righteous.
The LORD is full of compassion.
The LORD has been good to me.
My soul, return to your rest.
God has shown you kindness.
passages.original: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי׃

passages.text: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
passages.sermon:
The LORD delivered me.
He saved my soul from death.
He kept my eyes from tears.
He kept my feet from stumbling.
passages.original: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת־ עֵינִ֥י מִן־ דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת־ רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי׃

passages.text: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
passages.sermon:
I will walk before the LORD.
I will do this in the land of the living.
The LORD is God.
The land of the living is where people are alive.
I will live my life in God’s presence.
I will honor God as I live.

passages.text: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a believer in God.
The speaker trusted God.
The speaker spoke because of this faith.
The speaker said, "I am greatly afflicted."
The speaker experienced much suffering.
passages.original: הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a believer in God.
The speaker felt alarmed.
The speaker spoke quickly.
The speaker said, "All people lie."
The speaker believed that every person is untruthful.
passages.original: אֲ֭נִי אָמַ֣רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֑י כָּֽל־ הָאָדָ֥ם כֹּזֵֽב׃

passages.text: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
passages.sermon:
The LORD has shown me great goodness.
I have received many blessings from Him.
I ask, “How can I repay the LORD?”
I want to respond to all He has done for me.
passages.original: מָֽה־ אָשִׁ֥יב לַיהוָ֑ה כָּֽל־ תַּגְמוּל֥וֹהִי עָלָֽי׃

passages.text: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to God.
The psalmist trusts God.
The psalmist receives salvation from God.
The psalmist lifts the cup of salvation.
The psalmist calls on the name of the LORD.
passages.original: כּוֹס־ יְשׁוּע֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֑א וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃

passages.text: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a servant of the LORD.
The speaker has made vows to the LORD.
The speaker will fulfill these vows.
The speaker will do this before all the LORD’s people.
passages.original: נְ֭דָרַי לַיהוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה־ נָּ֝֗א לְכָל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
passages.sermon:
The LORD sees the death of His saints.
The LORD considers their death precious.
The LORD values His saints.
The LORD cares when His faithful ones die.

passages.text: Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker says, "O LORD, I am Your servant."
The speaker repeats, "I am Your servant."
The speaker says, "I am the son of Your maidservant."
The LORD has broken the speaker's bonds.
passages.original: אָֽנָּ֣ה יְהוָה֮ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֪י עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲ‍ֽנִי־ עַ֭בְדְּךָ בֶּן־ אֲמָתֶ֑ךָ פִּ֝תַּ֗חְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָֽי׃

passages.text: I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
passages.sermon: I will give You a sacrifice of thanksgiving.\r\nI will call on the name of the LORD.
passages.original: לְֽךָ־ אֶ֭זְבַּח זֶ֣בַח תּוֹדָ֑ה וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃

passages.text: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people, in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
passages.sermon:
I will fulfill my vows to the LORD.
I will do this in front of all His people.
I will stand in the courts of the LORD’s house.
I will be in your midst, O Jerusalem.
Praise the LORD!
passages.original: נְ֭דָרַי לַיהוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה־ נָּ֝֗א לְכָל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃ בְּחַצְר֤וֹת׀ בֵּ֤ית יְהוָ֗ה בְּֽת֘וֹכֵ֤כִי יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
